title: Tunnel Vision

shots.name: It never landed
shots.camera: Low road cam, 18 mm, exactly the Ep2 leap angle
shots.action: The Stalker is mid-leap over the lens, claws out, rain hanging around it. Hook text on frame 0 only.
shots.sound: Rain, its scream from Ep2 picking up mid-breath

shots.name: High beams
shots.camera: Handheld, rider's eye line, 24 mm, looking up
shots.action: Its body fills the sky above her. A white high beam blows out the left of frame and swings across its ribs.
shots.sound: V8 roars in from the left, a long horn blast

shots.name: T-bone
shots.camera: Low side-follow, 28 mm, keeps the Stalker centred
shots.action: The Night Terror hits the Stalker mid-air at about 70 km/h and carries it ten metres into the side of the box truck. Glass, sparks, the truck rocks.
shots.sound: Impact is the downbeat; score slams in. Metal, bone, glass rain

shots.name: Dashcam
shots.camera: The dash camcorder, 4:3 framing inside 9:16, VHS
shots.action: Open-cockpit crossbar camera; Sam jolts on impact. No windscreen. Cage and antlers scrape past.
shots.sound: Camcorder mic clipping, airbag-less thump, his grunt
shots.original_action: Same hit from inside. The windscreen spiders. Sam's hands jolt on the wheel, his glasses fly forward on the strap. Antlers scrape past the glass.

shots.name: Steam
shots.camera: Handheld documentary, eye height, walking in
shots.action: Damaged nose, radiator steam, dead LEFT lamp, wrecked trike; Sam climbs out through the cage opening.
shots.sound: Radiator hiss, ticking metal, car alarm far off
shots.original_action: Crumpled bonnet steaming in the rain, left headlight dead, the trike on its side. The driver door creaks open.

shots.name: Take my arm
shots.action: Sam reaches down. She locks his forearm, he hauls her up in one motion. First time they see each other. No words.

shots.name: Last belt
shots.action: She rips the empty bandolier off the trike, then the one live belt from the tray, and slings it. The 43rd round, finally.

shots.name: It moves
shots.camera: 20 mm on the asphalt under the truck
shots.action: In the puddle under the truck, an antler tip twitches. A clawed hand slaps flat into the water.
shots.sound: The click-growl, water slap. Score falls to a pulse

shots.name: Lift
shots.camera: Crash zoom up over the truck roof, then fast pull-back
shots.action: The truck tips up on one side. The camera rushes over the roof to its face pushing up from beneath, then rips back as Sam and the rider dive into the car.
shots.sound: Metal groan, sub swell, doors slam

shots.name: Screamer
shots.camera: Handheld wide, 35 mm, from street level
shots.action: On a rooftop, a thin silhouette arches back and screams. Windows down the whole street fill with running shapes.
shots.sound: Approved Screamer take; full drive kicks in

shots.name: J-turn
shots.action: The Night Terror reverses hard and spins 180Â° in one smooth arc, the single headlight sweeping across the horde, then drives away.
shots.sound: Gearbox whine, tyre scream, engine on the beat

shots.name: Gallop
shots.camera: Handheld from the back seat, through the rear window
shots.action: The Stalker on all fours behind them, gaining, the horde streaming behind it under the street lamps.

shots.name: On the roof
shots.action: Stalker hooks claws around and buckles upper roll-cage bars; rider fires upward three times through the open gap.
shots.sound: Roof hits on beats, three pistol shots, her shout
shots.needs: Sam, rider, car interior, Stalker claws
shots.original_action: THUNK. The roof dents in. Claws punch through the headliner between their heads. She fires the pistol straight up three times; each flash lights the cabin.

shots.name: Clearance 12'6"
shots.action: Tunnel concrete lip catches raised antlers and tears Stalker off the cage; anatomical LEFT antler snaps.
shots.sound: Crack of bone on concrete, roof scrape
shots.original_action: The tunnel mouth rushes in. The Stalker rises on the roof, antlers up. They hit the concrete lip; it is ripped off backwards and the left antler snaps.

shots.name: Antler
shots.camera: 20 mm on the tunnel floor, looking back
shots.action: The Stalker tumbles in the rain at the tunnel mouth and shrinks away. The broken antler skids along the asphalt right past the lens.
shots.sound: Antler skitter, score rings out under a low-pass sweep

shots.name: Breathe
shots.action: Open cockpit, camera facing both occupants. Reload, shaking driver hands, wind past bent cage.
shots.sound: No music. Engine ticks, wind, a drip
shots.original_action: Quiet. One headlight on tiled walls. She reloads with steady hands. Sam's hands shake on the wheel. Wind whistles through the claw holes.

shots.name: Traffic
shots.camera: Handheld over Sam's shoulder through the cracked glass
shots.action: Over Sam shoulder between cage bars; the single headlight reveals occupied abandoned cars.
shots.sound: Tyres on grit, brake squeak, silence
shots.original_action: The headlight crawls over a jam of abandoned cars filling the tunnel. The car rolls to a stop. In every car, someone is sitting upright.

shots.name: Heads turn
shots.camera: Slow handheld push toward one windscreen, 50 mm
shots.action: Every head turns into the light at once. Milky eyes catch the beam, two frames apart down the line.
shots.sound: Dozens of necks cracking, one breath held

shots.name: Click
shots.action: Black. Far behind them, from the tunnel mouth, the Stalker's click.
shots.sound: Sub hit, then the click, echoing

adaptation_authorized: Sam: use the buggy and adapt the cabin/roof sequence; make needed modifications and build
